maria_cs: Satellite.IO just pinged—demo today + EU pilot next week. They hit our default rate cap during a spike and asked for a temporary increase for the demo window. Also need EU region enabled and 3 IPs added to their allowlist. renewal flagged if we can't unblock tonight.

alex_se: Thanks, looping infra. Do we have capacity in eu-west for their model? They said low qps but bursts of 200rps for ~30m.

josh_eng_infra: Quick check — eu cluster has headroom but their tenant is on a shared hosted plan. We can 1) grant a temporary rate window bump, 2) route them to eu-west if they accept data residency note, or 3) offer a short Dedicated dev pool (sales). For now I can patch a per-tenant override for today. Need their org id + IPs.

maria_cs: Org ID: sat-9876. IPs: 18.32.12.1, 18.32.12.2, 18.32.12.3. Demo scheduled 18:30 UTC. Can you do a change for 18:20-19:00?

josh_eng_infra: Got it. I'll enqueue a temp rate rule: {"org_id":"sat-9876","window_start":"2026-03-14T18:20:00Z","window_end":"2026-03-14T19:00:00Z","qps_override":300} — applying now.

deploy-bot: Rate override created by josh_eng_infra for org sat-9876. ID: ro-20260314-332.

alex_se: Can we also add the IP allowlist entries to the tenant so their demo only uses those addresses?

josh_eng_infra: Adding IPs to tenant allowlist now. Patching config:
```
allowlist.sat-9876 = ["18.32.12.1","18.32.12.2","18.32.12.3"]
route_policy.sat-9876 = "eu-west"
```
Will validate via staging proxy.

sara_customer: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. If we can keep EU routing after pilot that's ideal.

kevin_sales: Noted — I'll update the renewal playbook to mark as at-risk until EU routing is confirmed. If they convert pilot to paid Dedicated we should propose a 6mo commit.

maria_cs: Action items: josh apply temp override + allowlist (done), alex validate routing and confirm latencies (<120ms target), kevin follow up on renewal/commercial, i'll send enablement docs and ask them to run the verification prompts.

alex_se: Latency check to eu-west on their sample set: p50=89ms p95=152ms. p95 is slightly over target for one of their regions, but demo UX should be fine. I'll send exact traces to maria.

maria_cs: Perfect. Kevin — can you set a renewal follow-up for 30 days post-pilot and mark the customer health as "watch"?

kevin_sales: Done — calendar + CRM note added. Tagging renewal-owner: @kevin_sales.

deploy-bot: Allowlist patch applied. Routing policy updated. Rollout complete.

maria_cs: Closing thread — demo covered. We'll reconvene if they request persistent EU tenancy or Dedicated. :party_parrot:
